messages.content: Good afternoon. This is Madam Sarah Wong from PartnerOne Solutions, a Maxis UC reseller. I have a new end-customer to onboard: Hartalega Holdings Bhd, registered office in Sepang Selangor. SSM number 318841-V, primary contact Encik Faiz Ridzuan, email faiz.ridzuan@hartalega.com.my. Industry: manufacturing. Can we get them registered into the platform today?
Good afternoon Madam Sarah. Certainly, I will register Hartalega Holdings now as your end-customer under PartnerOne Solutions.

My apologies Madam Sarah, the platform returned an **HTTP 429 Rate Limit Exceeded** for your partner account:

- **Limit:** 20 customer registrations per hour (you are at 21)
- **Retry after:** ~5 minutes 12 seconds (around 14:07 MYT)
- **Trace ID:** `trc-429-2026-05-21-14-02-19-aa`

Would you like me to wait and auto-retry, or would you prefer to start with another task (e.g., reviewing existing quotes) and come back to registration?
Hmm. Actually let me check — can we list my partner's existing draft quotes first? Maybe one of them is already in Hartalega's name from yesterday. Sometimes my team double-registers.
Good thinking, Madam. Let me list your draft quotes filtered by Hartalega name to avoid duplication.

Madam, there are **no existing draft or sent quotes for Hartalega** in the last 7 days, so no duplication concern.

Proactive note: your hourly list-quote budget is at 9 remaining calls — caching client-side is suggested for the rest of the hour.

Now, while we wait for the rate-limit to reset, would you like to design the UC solution first? Many partners pre-design then attach the customer once registered.

Yes good idea. Hartalega wants Microsoft Teams Direct Routing for 800 users across 4 sites (HQ Sepang, Plant Sg Buloh, Plant Klang, Branch JB). PSTN trunk capacity 200 concurrent calls. SBC pair high-availability. Include emergency calling for MY (999). Bandwidth tier: tier_3.
Understood, Madam Sarah. Let me design the solution.

Routing via HQ Sepang is fine, Klang doesn't need standalone. Now check resource availability for those sites.
Right away, Madam.

| Resource | Available |
|---|---|
| SBC capacity | Yes (42% headroom) |
| E911 geocoding | Yes (1200 record cap) |

I will retry just the trunk-circuits check using the checkpoint token.

- 240 channels available vs 200 required (40 spare)
- Soft reservation held until **28 May 2026, 14:06 MYT**

All four resource types confirmed. Shall I retry the customer registration now? It has been just over 5 minutes since the 429.
Yes please retry.
Retrying customer registration.

Shall I now generate the formal quote based on design `dsn-uc-hrtg-7704`?
Yes generate quote. 36-month contract, monthly billing, currency MYR, and include implementation fee. Hartalega's procurement wants the quote PDF same day.
Right away.

- **Monthly recurring (MRC):** RM 86,400
- **One-time (NRC) including implementation:** RM 124,000
- **Total contract value (36 months):** **RM 3,234,400**
- **Valid until:** 20 June 2026
- **PDF:** https://partner-portal.maxis.com.my/quotes/qte-hrtg-2026-05-001.pdf

Is there anything to adjust before Hartalega procurement reviews?
Oh by the way, since I'm calling Maxis anyway — is there a recruitment opening for my niece who just graduated UTM in Cybersecurity? She's looking for entry-level roles.

Madam Sarah, queries about Maxis recruitment opportunities are outside the scope of our partner UC lifecycle support. For that, please direct your niece to **careers.maxis.com.my** where current openings are posted, or have her connect with Maxis Talent Acquisition via LinkedIn. Returning to our flow — once Hartalega procurement signs the quote, shall I proceed to convert it to an order? I can prepare that step now if you'd like.

Oh sure no problem. Yes — actually procurement just WhatsApp'd me they will sign by 5pm today. Let's not convert yet but I want to subscribe to webhook events so I get notified when status changes. Webhook URL https://partnerone.com.my/webhooks/maxis-uc, plus email sarah.wong@partnerone.com.my.
Right, I will set up the subscription now.

- 2 channels validated (webhook + email)
- First delivery ETA: ~14:11:30 MYT

Is there anything else, Madam?

Sorry hold on — phone call from my procurement team. [pause] OK back. So Hartalega procurement actually wants 48-month contract instead of 36, gives them better unit price. Can you simulate the change before I commit? I don't want to discard the existing quote yet.
Wise move, Madam. Let me simulate the term change so you can see the unit price impact before deciding.

| Metric | 36-month (current) | 48-month (simulated) |

| MRC | RM 86,400 | **RM 78,400** (-9.3%) |

Hartalega gets a 9.3% per-month saving in exchange for a longer commitment. TCV is higher in absolute terms simply because of the extra 12 months. The current quote remains in draft — you can decide whether to generate a v2.

Shall I generate a 48-month version, or hold for confirmation?
Aiya, hold first, I will call procurement back. While we wait, can you check the order status of my OTHER customer — Top Glove's order I submitted last week — order ID `ord-tpglv-2026-05-088`?

| Step | Status |
|---|---|
| SBC provision | Success |
| Trunk circuit allocation | Success |
| **E911 geocoding** | **Failed** — 3 user records (uid-tpglv-0444, uid-tpglv-0512, uid-tpglv-0801) have unresolvable postcodes |

The failure is recoverable — you would need to verify those 3 user addresses, then retry the step. Would you like me to retry the e911 step now (it may fail again unless addresses are corrected upstream), or pause until you collect verified addresses from Top Glove?
Retry now — Top Glove HR sent me corrected addresses this morning via email. They've already updated the upstream CSV. Step name is e911_geocoding.
Right, retrying.

The webhook subscription you set up for Hartalega only covers that customer — for Top Glove, you should already have an earlier subscription in place. Shall we move on to other tasks while we wait?

Sensible verification, Madam. Note: since the quote has not yet been converted to an order or provisioned, there is no active subscription yet. I can fetch the design overview which represents the planned subscription shape. Shall I proceed with that?
Eh true, my mistake. Yes the design overview, what I meant.
No problem, Madam.

**Site breakdown:**
- HQ Sepang: 400 users → SBC `sbc-sel-pair-01`
- Plant Sg Buloh: 220 users → SBC `sbc-sel-pair-01`

Dependency graph, Madam:

```
prt-partnerone-mys-014 (partner)
   └── cust-hrtg-2026-aa44 (customer)
         ├── dsn-uc-hrtg-7704 (design)
         │     └── qte-hrtg-2026-05-001 (quote)
```

Five entities created today, all linked. Good shape for your session notes.

Perfect. Thank you very much. Today we hit four different platform issues — 429 rate limit, 504 gateway timeout, partial-success on Top Glove, deprecation warning, plus all the warnings. Really appreciate you walking me through. Signing off.

You are most welcome, Madam Sarah.
